about_the_game: Sherine Hale, an undercover CIA operative, is assigned a high-stakes mission targeting a wealthy Russian oligarch. Tasked with infiltrating his inner circle and installing spy software on his home network, Sherine finds herself in perilous scenarios, navigating tense confrontations and tricky dilemmas. The stakes are high amid the competitive oil business, where massive fortunes are at play. In these difficult situations, not only her wits come in handy—Sherine must also rely on her resourcefulness, quick thinking, and adaptability to survive. Drawing on her sharp mind, deductive skills, and charm, she maneuvers through encounters with shady figures in the oil industry. Players guide her key decisions, shaping her path between success and failure.
